A kind-hearted witch has watched over the land for centuries — but now something has fallen out of tune. On their journey, players will discover the many lives and heartfelt stories that make up the world of Hela. Kingdom of Night is an 80s-inspired isometric action RPG where coming-of-age drama meets cosmic horror.

When a satanic cult unleashes the ancient evil Baphomet on the small town of Miami, Arizona, high school student John must fight through a night of demonic chaos to rescue his friends before the town is lost forever.

Choose from five distinct classes: Barbarian, Knight, Rogue, Necromancer, or Sorcerer, and customize your build with expansive skill trees, powerful loot, and unique equipment. Explore the town freely, battle terrifying Demon Generals in any order, uncover the stories of Miami's residents, and descend into massive demon lairs.

Face the apocalypse alone or team up with a friend in two-player local co-op to save Miami before the night ends.

Friday night just became the end of the world.

“I am a shooting star! A spark meant to shine and vanish in a blink. But I will travel! I will mark my trail in every firmament. I will live to see the universe.”

Faraway is a randomly-generated, minimalistic and demanding, arcade-puzzle game about a shooting star that designs constellations to stay alive. With immersive realtime visuals and interactive music, it’s a game of long-term mastery. You can play in quick bites or hours-long sessions, making it the perfect game to revisit for years to come.

Created single-handedly by game designer, creative coder, and musician Steph Thirion, creator of the cult game Eliss, Faraway is an immersive minimalistic game of deep expressive play, made for discovery, replay, and long-term mastery.

Faraway is out now on PlayStation 5.

#ps5 #ps5games #faraway
title: Faraway - Launch Trailer | PS5 Games
